# Alphabetical order for player-visible enumerations

Rule (Timothy): enumerations of game things with no inherent order are listed
alphabetically by the DISPLAYED English name, case-insensitive. Orders that carry
meaning are kept. Inventory made before any change; SORT = changed, KEEP = left.

## Codex (`web/static/codex/*.md`; `articles.json` is regenerated by `python3 tools/codex_facts.py`)

| Where | List | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| `terrain.md`, `goods.md`, `buildings.md`, `gods.md` hubs (`<!-- list: ... -->`, built by `tools/codex_facts.py`) | terrains, goods, buildings, gods | SORT (generator sorts hub rows by displayed title) |
| `ship-types.md:3` hub (explicit keys) | galley, war galley, emporos | SORT (key order in the marker) |
| Codex index (`ui/codex.js renderIndex`) | articles inside each category | SORT, except sequence categories: Start here, Founding |
| `glossary.md` | glossary entries | SORT |
| `units.md:9-16` recruit table; `battle.md:11-17` dice table | unit rows | SORT |
| `ship-types.md:70-76` mission table | Explore, Land, March, Passage, Patrol | SORT |
| `roads.md:10-16` traveller table; `fishing.md:3-8` water table | rows | SORT |
| `stances.md:5-7` | fortify / storm / sentry | SORT |
| `roads.md:20,30-33`, `marching.md:62-70`, `founding.md:46`, `how-do-i.md:33`, `lake.md:5`, `naming-the-land.md`, `telling-of-places.md:1` | terrain / place-kind lists in prose | SORT inside the list; value-ordered groups (1 / 1.5 / 2 / 3 game days) keep group order |
| `temples.md:1,5,17`, `rites.md:35` | gods, deposits in prose | SORT |
| food lists in `food.md`, `goods.md`, `growth.md`, `upkeep.md`, `granary.md`, `sieges.md`, `glossary.md`, `coming-back.md`, `ship-types.md`, `livestock.md`, `citizens.md` | "grain, fish and oil" | SORT -> "fish, grain and oil" |
| goods / deposits / buildings / units in prose: `founding.md`, `exploration.md`, `mine.md`, `buildings.md`, `potnias-vision.md`, `rites.md`, `terrain.md`, `transfers.md`, `routes.md`, `incense.md`, `war-chariot.md`, `units.md` | | SORT |
| generated cost strings (`costs()` in `tools/codex_facts.py`: all "Cost" rows, prayer offerings) and hand-written cost cells | `grain . timber . cedar . stone . bronze ...` | SORT alphabetically by good |
| `marching.md:62-70`, `roads.md:28-33` | travel-time / stone groups ordered by value | KEEP group order |
| `kharis.md` moods, `transfers.md:29-33` outcomes, `fishing.md:24-29` and `temples.md:19-23` levels | ordered by value or level | KEEP |
| `how-do-i.md` | tasks grouped by what you want to do | KEEP (task order; ask Timothy) |
| `rites.md:33-42` prayers | grouped by god and by kind | KEEP (ask Timothy) |
| `occupation.md:9-14` sack / burn / annex | escalation | KEEP |
| `screen.md` drawer table and toolbar | mirrors on-screen order | KEEP |
| `sight.md:9-15` | sight ranges mixed with modifiers | KEEP (ask Timothy) |
| `keryx.md:24-35` example commands | curated first-steps sequence | KEEP |
| numbered lists, `welcome.md` first steps | steps | KEEP |
